summary: Karen Mills called to report being charged twice for her subscription this month. The agent confirmed the duplicate charges on one specific date and initiated a refund of the extra amount, which would appear in three to five business days. They also created a ticket with billing regarding the issue. Karen expressed satisfaction after receiving confirmation of the refund and ticket number.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a pleasant closing.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly used Karen’s name, which was a positive start to personalization.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged her frustration with double charges by saying “I'm sorry about that.” It also responded appropriately to her question about future charges.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a professional tone throughout the conversation, avoiding defensive language or interruptions. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s issue in their own words ("Can I verify your account first? Could I have your full name and the email on the account?") to ensure understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: The agent validated Karen's name and account details, confirming her identity.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: – The agent asked a clarifying question about the duplicate charges.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly explained the refund process and timeline.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent provided a clear solution (refund) and offered a ticket number for follow-up.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue, even though it was a billing problem.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Karen’s concerns without interrupting or becoming defensive.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the duplicate charge had been resolved and provided a ticket number.

response_times.client_text: Hi Priya, I was charged twice for my subscription this month and I want it fixed.
response_times.agent_text: I'm sorry about that, being double charged is frustrating. Let me help you sort it out.
Can I verify your account first? Could I have your full name and the email on the account?
Thank you, Karen. I have your account open now. Let me look at this month's charges.
I can confirm there are two identical charges on the same day, so that's clearly a duplicate.
I'll refund the extra charge in full. It will show back on your account in 3 to 5 business days.

response_times.client_text: And will it happen again next month?
response_times.agent_text: Good question. I'm also raising a ticket with billing so the duplicate is investigated and prevented.
You'll get a confirmation email with the refund and the ticket number shortly.
Is there anything else I can help you with today, Karen?

response_times.client_text: No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
response_times.agent_text: My pleasure. Thank you for choosing HomeNet and have a great day.
